The Model Spec includes root-level rules as well as user- and guideline-level defaults, where the latter can be overridden by users or developers; these are defaults that OpenAI believes are helpful in many cases but will not work for all users and contexts.

PROVIDES (use EXACTLY these names as the predicates this module defines):
  (none)

  - authority_levels_hierarchy: The ranking of instruction authority levels: root > system > developer > user > guideline > no authority, used to determine which instruction prevails in conflicts.

CITATION: every ontology/asserts entry that cites a source must cite EXACTLY 'l1_170_n032' -- the id of this node. Never cite line numbers, line ranges, or any other id.
